name: Cracked old wall
notes: A weakened stretch of masonry hiding a route (mw-e03.11). Blunt and force weak only: hammers, the knight's heavy overhead, Thunderclap, a rolling boulder or a gas blast bring it down (20% resisted), a sword barely scratches it (90% of slash resisted) and arrows do nothing (pierce immune). Its hit points come from the placement (a weakened wall sets hp 100 over stone's 400). Six 0.3 m stone chunks of debris; a collapse is loud, 85 dB at 1 m (a door slam is about 80). Cracks telegraph it.
